## Purpose
Section card listing publications, talks and sessions as link tiles with title, conference or journal, authors and description. It shows skeleton tiles while loading.

## Key concepts
- `PublicationCard({publications, loading})`; `SanitizedPublication` from [[src-interfaces]], `skeleton` from [[src-utils]].
- Optional fields (`conferenceName`, `journalName`, `authors`, `description`) are each rendered only when present.
- Tiles are plain `<a target=_blank>` links with no analytics tracking.

## Gotchas
- The section heading is hardcoded as "Presentations & Sessions" rather than passed as a prop.
- Skeleton count is `publications.length`, so an empty list shows no skeletons while loading.
